# Sunstone House

> Furnished monthly rooms in a shared co-living house in Kenton, North Portland, Oregon (97217). Six listed private furnished rooms across two units. Month-to-month with a 31-day minimum stay, utilities included, no deposit on private contracts through RentRedi. No pets, no smoking.

## Listed rooms (monthly rent, utilities included)

- Opal (Unit A2) — $1,300/mo, queen bed, 160 sq ft, floor 2 — open now
- Azurite (Unit C6) — $1,100/mo, single bed, floor 2 — open now
- Kunzite (Unit C5) — $1,100/mo, twin bed, petite room — open now
- Sapphire (Unit C1) — $1,350/mo, queen bed, 220 sq ft, floor 2 — opens November 1, 2026
- Emerald (Unit C2) — $1,300/mo, queen bed, 198 sq ft, floor 2, A/C — opens November 2, 2026
- Lapis (Unit C4) — $1,100/mo, single bed, floor 1 — booked until late November 2026

Other rooms in the house are not publicly listed.

## House facts

- Shared kitchen, shared baths, in-house washer/dryer (coin-free, detergent supplied), housekeeping, on-site management
- Terms: month-to-month, 31-day minimum, utilities built into rent, no deposit (tenants are responsible for any damage), no pets, no smoking
- Quiet hours: 10 pm to 7 am. Business hours: 8 am to 5 pm
- Guests bring clothes, food, and a laptop — rooms are fully furnished
